授業科目の概要.科目名称: Active Japanese Ⅰ（アクティブ日本語　Ⅰ）
授業科目の概要.講義題目: Japanese to Connect with the World
授業科目の概要.授業科目区分: 外国人留学生に共通の授業科目
授業科目の概要.使用言語: 英語及び日本語を併用（E/J）

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: コミュニケーションで大切なのは、言語の知識そのものでなく、言語を使って何ができるかです。本科目では、CEFR（ヨーロッパ共通言語参照枠)の考えを取り入れ、行動中心（Can-do statement）通して、日本語で人、地域社会、世界とつながる力を養成します。具体的には、「自分のことや自分の考えを伝える」、「相手と対話をする」ための日本語力を身につけます。また、シミュレーションとロールプレイなどの様々な会話練習を通して、効果的に日本語のプロフィシェンシー(熟達度)を高めていきます。更に、授業を通して自国や外国の文化についても学び異文化理解を深め、異文化コミュニケーションのスキルも高めます。この授業では、課題に取り組むことで、授業内容に関連した漢字語彙や日本語の作文も並行して学ぶことができます。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: TThis course is designed to help students develop their Japanese language skills in line with the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). Students will learn the language and focus on applying their knowledge to real-world situations. They can measure and track their progress in effectively communicating across various contexts using can-do statements. The course aims to empower students to express themselves clearly and communicate confidently with others. Interactive activities such as simulations and role-playing will be incorporated into the lessons to facilitate this. These practices will improve their language skills and enhance their understanding of cultural nuances. Students will gain insights into their culture and others, fostering stronger intercultural communication skills. In addition to developing speaking and listening abilities, the course will expand students' vocabulary and knowledge of Kanji. Online assignments and writing exercises, including paragraph writing, will provide opportunities for further practice outside class. By the end of the course, students will have greater confidence in their Japanese language abilities and be better equipped to communicate effectively in diverse settings.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: 日本語、異文化理解、コミュニケーション
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: To have already obtained CEFR A2 language skills equivalent to JLPT N4 Level or have completed Elementary 2 (Level 3) of JACs and JLT provided by the International Student Center of Kyushu University.
